raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Part 10 of 21 of the LoRA runtime stack (branch `lora-stack-09-moe-plans`, base `lora-stack-08-inkling-sink`). The stack is cut from the development branch of #42284.

## What this part adds

Add the MoE plan model (MoePlan, A/B families and specs, act and finalize
families, the ActivationFn enum), the plan loader with load-time validation,
the default table, and the SGLANG_LORA_MOE_CONFIG_DIR override. A device
without a tuned table serves the default plans.

Tests: spec and pipeline validation, fusion ownership, route-requirement
union, token-dense bridge ownership.

## Verification

- H200 run r41 (2026-10-19): the tree of upstream main `33dd8f6a2eee` plus parts 01–10 imports every module this part changes and passes this part's tests together with every earlier part's unit tests: **564 passed, 20 warnings, 189 subtests passed in 33.44s**.
- `pre-commit` passed on the changed files of every part; `pre-commit run --all-files` passed on the complete stack tree.

The complete 21-part tree equals the development branch of #42284 at `4e92ccf664` (the `5f1092b446` tree rebased onto upstream main `33dd8f6a2eee`; the three engine commits are unchanged apart from the dense commit's conflict resolutions in the runner imports, the decode-graph warmup hook and the MLA-correction imports) minus the benchmark tools and the Triton MoE tuning tables, which follow in separate PRs.

@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+# MoE LoRA execution plans
+
+`<arch>.plans.json` selects the base row layout and LoRA execution stages for
+`lora_triton`, `lora_cutedsl` and `lora_marlin`. Supported capability majors
+9 and 10 select `sm90` and `sm100`, respectively. Other architectures,
+including SM120, are unsupported. A missing table uses `default.plans.json`.
+
+## Selection and overrides
+
+`SGLANG_LORA_MOE_CONFIG_DIR` supplies override files before packaged files.
+Tables are process-cached; use a fresh server to evaluate an override.
+
+The file contains a tuned `domain`, ordered `scenarios`, and conservative
+`fallback` rows. Scenario selection matches adapter layout, phase, pool rank,
+resident expert count and quantization. Shapes outside the tuned domain use
+fallback rows. Row names are labels, not selectors.
+
+Each row declares:
+
+- `base_gemm_rows`: `expert_major` or `route_major`;
+- `plan`: A/B, activation and finalization families plus overlap and routing;
+- `tiles`: ordered rank/token rules containing per-site launch configurations.
+
+Rank filters are applied before the first matching token bound is selected.
+An unbounded token rule ends that rank's ladder. `{ "sites": {} }` or no
+surviving rank rule uses launch defaults; a supplied site section must be
+complete. Invalid keys, tiles or shadowed ladders fail at loading, even in an
+unselected row.
+
+The plan determines which route views and buffers are consumed. Per-expert
+adapters have factors for each resident expert; shared-outer adapters share
+the gate/up A and down B factors across experts. Raw views retain token/expert
+pairs. Aligned views bucket and pad pairs for grouped kernels. Shared-token
+plans instead group one row per token. Route construction must not create
+views the selected stages do not need.
+
+Runtime orchestration remains in `srt/lora`: MoE plans, runner and base-GEMM
+providers under `srt/lora/moe`, the shared workspace in `srt/lora/workspace.py`.
+Device kernels live in `kernels/ops/lora/common` for
+shared routing/A/B operations and `kernels/ops/lora/moe` for MoE stages and
+CuTeDSL kernels. Existing upstream LoRA registry and dense token kernels keep
+their paths.
+
+## Tuning and evidence
+
+Search bounded launch tiles while retaining plan families and base-GEMM
+configurations. Whole-runner fixture timings are not model TPS. Base-GEMM
+tables have a separate schema and admission policy.
+
+New production rows need numerical checks, independent locked validation and
+model-level target/control measurements on their exact device and affected
+selector regions. Do not copy isolated kernel winners into broader rules or
+treat aggregate gains as proof that every cell is regression-free.
+
+Historical exploration and measurements remain in Git history; private
+campaign paths and retired tools are not part of the public tuning contract.

@@ -0,0 +1,759 @@
+"""Select and validate MoE LoRA plans and their launch tiles."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from enum import Enum
+from functools import cache
+from typing import Any, Literal, Mapping
+
+import pydantic
+from pydantic.dataclasses import dataclass as pydantic_dataclass
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.lora.moe.activation import ActivationFn
+from sglang.srt.lora.utils import Phase
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_STRICT = pydantic.ConfigDict(strict=True, extra="forbid")
+
+
+class Site(str, Enum):
+    GATE_UP = "gate_up"
+    DOWN = "down"
+
+
+class BridgeLayout(str, Enum):
+    PAIR_MAJOR = "pair_major"
+    TOKEN_MAJOR = "token_major"
+
+
+class RouteRequirement(str, Enum):
+    RAW_PER_EXPERT = "raw_per_expert"
+    RAW_SHARED_OUTER = "raw_shared_outer"
+    ALIGNED_PER_EXPERT = "aligned_per_expert"
+    ALIGNED_SHARED_OUTER = "aligned_shared_outer"
+    SHARED_TOKEN_PLAN = "shared_token_plan"
+
+
+class RouteBuilderFamily(str, Enum):
+    STANDARD = "standard"
+    # Build the shared route on the workspace side stream.
+    PARALLEL_SHARED_OUTER = "parallel_shared_outer"
+
+
+class AFamily(str, Enum):
+    GROUPED = "grouped"
+    PER_ROW = "per_row"
+    TOKEN_GROUPED = "token_grouped"
+    # Shared gate/up A writes one token-domain bridge plane per adapter slot.
+    TOKEN_DENSE = "token_dense"
+
+
+class BFamily(str, Enum):
+    GROUPED = "grouped"
+    PER_ROW = "per_row"
+
+
+class ActFamily(str, Enum):
+    MATERIALIZED = "materialized"
+    B_ACTIVATION = "b_activation"
+
+
+class FinalizeFamily(str, Enum):
+    MATERIALIZED = "materialized"
+    # Reduce in rank space before expanding the shared B once per token.
+    SHARED_TOKEN_DELTA = "shared_token_delta"
+    # Fuse the rank reduction, B expansion, and base reduction.
+    SHARED_ONE_PASS = "shared_one_pass"
+
+
+class GateUpOverlap(str, Enum):
+    NONE = "none"
+    GATE_UP_A = "gate_up_a"
+    GATE_UP_A_B = "gate_up_a_b"
+
+
+class DownOverlap(str, Enum):
+    NONE = "none"
+    DOWN_A = "down_a"
+    DOWN_A_B = "down_a_b"
+
+
+def _raw_requirement(is_shared_outer: bool) -> RouteRequirement:
+    if is_shared_outer:
+        return RouteRequirement.RAW_SHARED_OUTER
+    return RouteRequirement.RAW_PER_EXPERT
+
+
+def _aligned_requirement(is_shared_outer: bool) -> RouteRequirement:
+    if is_shared_outer:
+        return RouteRequirement.ALIGNED_SHARED_OUTER
+    return RouteRequirement.ALIGNED_PER_EXPERT
+
+
+def _check_down_bridge_layout(site: Site, layout: BridgeLayout) -> None:
+    if site is Site.DOWN and layout is BridgeLayout.TOKEN_MAJOR:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "the down bridge is inherently pair-major: each routed expert "
+            "produces a different activation"
+        )
+
+
+@pydantic_dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, config=_STRICT)
+class ASpec:
+    site: Site
+    family: AFamily
+    is_shared_outer: bool = False
+    output_layout: BridgeLayout = BridgeLayout.PAIR_MAJOR
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        _check_down_bridge_layout(self.site, self.output_layout)
+        if self.family in (AFamily.GROUPED, AFamily.PER_ROW):
+            if self.output_layout is not BridgeLayout.PAIR_MAJOR:
+                raise ValueError(f"{self.family.value} A writes a pair-major bridge")
+        else:
+            if self.site is not Site.GATE_UP:
+                raise ValueError(f"{self.family.value} is a shared gate/up-A family")
+            if not self.is_shared_outer:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"{self.family.value} requires shared-outer A ownership"
+                )
+            if self.output_layout is not BridgeLayout.TOKEN_MAJOR:
+                raise ValueError(f"{self.family.value} writes a token-major bridge")
+
+    def route_requirements(self) -> frozenset[RouteRequirement]:
+        if self.family in (
+            AFamily.PER_ROW,
+            AFamily.TOKEN_DENSE,
+        ):
+            return frozenset((_raw_requirement(self.is_shared_outer),))
+        if self.family is AFamily.TOKEN_GROUPED:
+            return frozenset((RouteRequirement.SHARED_TOKEN_PLAN,))
+        return frozenset((_aligned_requirement(self.is_shared_outer),))
+
+
+@pydantic_dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, config=_STRICT)
+class BSpec:
+    site: Site
+    family: BFamily
+    is_shared_outer: bool = False
+    input_layout: BridgeLayout = BridgeLayout.PAIR_MAJOR
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        _check_down_bridge_layout(self.site, self.input_layout)
+
+    def route_requirements(self) -> frozenset[RouteRequirement]:
+        if self.family is BFamily.PER_ROW:
+            return frozenset((_raw_requirement(self.is_shared_outer),))
+        return frozenset((_aligned_requirement(self.is_shared_outer),))
+
+
+@pydantic_dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, config=_STRICT)
+class ActSpec:
+    """B_ACTIVATION owns gate/up B and consumes the A bridge."""
+
+    family: ActFamily
+    activation: ActivationFn
+
+    def route_requirements(self) -> frozenset[RouteRequirement]:
+        if self.family is not ActFamily.B_ACTIVATION:
+            return frozenset()
+        return frozenset((_aligned_requirement(False),))
+
+
+@pydantic_dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, config=_STRICT)
+class FinalizeSpec:
+    family: FinalizeFamily
+    is_shared_outer: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if (
+            self.family
+            in (FinalizeFamily.SHARED_TOKEN_DELTA, FinalizeFamily.SHARED_ONE_PASS)
+            and not self.is_shared_outer
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.family.value} requires shared-outer down-B ownership"
+            )
+
+    def route_requirements(self) -> frozenset[RouteRequirement]:
+        if self.family is FinalizeFamily.MATERIALIZED:
+            return frozenset()
+        if self.family is FinalizeFamily.SHARED_TOKEN_DELTA:
+            return frozenset(
+                (
+                    _raw_requirement(self.is_shared_outer),
+                    RouteRequirement.SHARED_TOKEN_PLAN,
+                )
+            )
+        return frozenset((_raw_requirement(self.is_shared_outer),))
+
+
+@pydantic_dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True, config=_STRICT)
+class MoePlan:
+    gate_up_a: ASpec
+    gate_up_b: BSpec | None = None
+    act: ActSpec
+    down_a: ASpec
+    down_b: BSpec | None = None
+    finalize: FinalizeSpec
+    gate_up_overlap: GateUpOverlap = GateUpOverlap.NONE
+    down_overlap: DownOverlap = DownOverlap.NONE
+    down_b_into_base: bool = False
+    route_builder: RouteBuilderFamily = RouteBuilderFamily.STANDARD
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.gate_up_a.site is not Site.GATE_UP:
+            raise ValueError("gate_up_a must describe the gate/up site")
+        if self.gate_up_b is not None and self.gate_up_b.site is not Site.GATE_UP:
+            raise ValueError("gate_up_b must describe the gate/up site")
+        if self.down_a.site is not Site.DOWN:
+            raise ValueError("down_a must describe the down site")
+        if self.down_b is not None and self.down_b.site is not Site.DOWN:
+            raise ValueError("down_b must describe the down site")
+
+        gate_up_b_consumed = self.act.family is ActFamily.B_ACTIVATION
+        if gate_up_b_consumed == (self.gate_up_b is not None):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "gate/up B must have exactly one owner: standalone gate_up_b or the act stage"
+            )
+        down_b_consumed = self.finalize.family is not FinalizeFamily.MATERIALIZED
+        if down_b_consumed == (self.down_b is not None):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "down B must have exactly one owner: standalone down_b or finalize"
+            )
+
+        # Fused consumers inherit A's layout; standalone B must match it.
+        if (
+            self.gate_up_b is not None
+            and self.gate_up_a.output_layout is not self.gate_up_b.input_layout
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "gate/up A output layout must match the gate/up B input layout"
+            )
+        if (
+            self.down_b is not None
+            and self.down_a.output_layout is not self.down_b.input_layout
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("down A output layout must match the down B input layout")
+        if self.gate_up_a.family is AFamily.TOKEN_DENSE and (
+            self.gate_up_b is None or self.gate_up_b.family is not BFamily.PER_ROW
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "token_dense A writes one bridge plane per adapter slot; only a "
+                "standalone per_row gate/up B selects planes"
+            )
+
+        if self.gate_up_overlap is GateUpOverlap.GATE_UP_A_B and self.gate_up_b is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "gate/up-A+B overlap requires standalone gate/up B; the act stage owns it"
+            )
+        if self.down_overlap is DownOverlap.DOWN_A_B and self.down_b is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"{self.down_overlap.value} overlap requires standalone down B"
+            )
+
+        # In-place B must wait for the base down GEMM to finish writing.
+        if self.down_b_into_base and not (
+            self.down_b is not None
+            and self.down_overlap in (DownOverlap.NONE, DownOverlap.DOWN_A)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "down-B into-base requires a standalone down-B stage and no "
+                "late overlap window (it read-modify-writes the base down "
+                "output)"
+            )
+
+    def route_requirements(self) -> frozenset[RouteRequirement]:
+        requirements: set[RouteRequirement] = set()
+        for stage in (
+            self.gate_up_a,
+            self.gate_up_b,
+            self.act,
+            self.down_a,
+            self.finalize,
+        ):
+            if stage is not None:
+                requirements.update(stage.route_requirements())
+        if self.down_b is not None:
+            # The in-place B kernel replaces the selected family with aligned rows.
+            if self.down_b_into_base:
+                requirements.add(_aligned_requirement(self.down_b.is_shared_outer))
+            else:
+                requirements.update(self.down_b.route_requirements())
+        return frozenset(requirements)
+
+
+def _a_default() -> dict[str, int]:
+    return {
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_N": 32,
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_K": 64,
+        "GROUP_SIZE_M": 8,
+        "num_warps": 4,
+        "num_stages": 2,
+    }
+
+
+def _b_default() -> dict[str, int]:
+    return {
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_M": 16,
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_N": 64,
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_K": 32,
+        "GROUP_SIZE_M": 8,
+        "num_warps": 4,
+        "num_stages": 2,
+    }
+
+
+def _b_act_default() -> dict[str, int]:
+    return {
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_W": 64,
+        "BLOCK_SIZE_K": 32,
+        "GROUP_SIZE_M": 8,
+        "num_warps": 4,
+        "num_stages": 3,
+    }
+
+
+def _shared_token_delta_default() -> dict[str, dict[str, int]]:
+    return {
+        "reduce": {"BLOCK_SIZE_T": 32, "num_warps": 4, "num_stages": 2},
+        "tail": {"BLOCK_SIZE_H": 128, "num_warps": 4, "num_stages": 3},
+    }
+
+
+def _shared_one_pass_default() -> dict[str, int]:
+    return {"BLOCK_SIZE_H": 128, "num_warps": 4, "num_stages": 3}
+
+
+def _is_power_of_two(value: int) -> bool:
+    return value > 0 and value & (value - 1) == 0
+
+
+def _validate_flat_config(
+    name: str, config: Mapping[str, int], allowed: frozenset[str]
+) -> None:
+    if not config:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a non-empty launch-config mapping")
+    unknown = set(config) - allowed
+    if unknown:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} has unknown launch keys: {sorted(unknown)}")
+    required = allowed - {"GROUP_SIZE_M", "BLOCK_SIZE_M", "SPLIT_K"}
+    missing = required - set(config)
+    if missing:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} is missing launch keys: {sorted(missing)}")
+    for key, value in config.items():
+        if value <= 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name}.{key} must be positive")
+        if (
+            key.startswith("BLOCK_SIZE_") or key in ("num_warps", "SPLIT_K")
+        ) and not _is_power_of_two(value):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name}.{key} must be a power of two")
+
+
+_GEMM_LAUNCH_KEYS = frozenset(
+    ("BLOCK_SIZE_N", "BLOCK_SIZE_K", "GROUP_SIZE_M", "num_warps", "num_stages")
+)
+
+
+@pydantic_dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True, kw_only=True, config=_STRICT)
+class MoeLoraLaunchConfig:
+    """Per-site Triton launch configs of one plan row."""
+
+    # Shared row tile for aligned LoRA kernels; independent of base-GEMM tiles.
+    routing_block_size: int = 16
+    gate_up_a: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=_a_default)
+    gate_up_b: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=_b_default)
+    down_a: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=_a_default)
+    down_b: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=_b_default)
+    b_activation: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=_b_act_default)
+    shared_token_delta: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = field(
+        default_factory=_shared_token_delta_default
+    )
+    shared_one_pass: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=_shared_one_pass_default)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        # tl.dot requires a power-of-two row tile of at least 16.
+        if (
+            not _is_power_of_two(self.routing_block_size)
+            or self.routing_block_size < 16
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("routing_block_size must be a power of two >= 16")
+        # MoE consumes the combined shrink output, so split-K is serial.
+        for name in ("gate_up_a", "down_a"):
+            _validate_flat_config(
+                name, getattr(self, name), _GEMM_LAUNCH_KEYS | {"SPLIT_K"}
+            )
+        for name in ("gate_up_b", "down_b"):
+            _validate_flat_config(
+                name, getattr(self, name), _GEMM_LAUNCH_KEYS | {"BLOCK_SIZE_M"}
+            )
+        _validate_flat_config(
+            "b_activation",
+            self.b_activation,
+            (_GEMM_LAUNCH_KEYS - {"BLOCK_SIZE_N"}) | {"BLOCK_SIZE_W"},
+        )
+        # Grouped B takes its row tile from the route, not its config section.
+        for name in ("gate_up_b", "down_b"):
+            declared = getattr(self, name).get("BLOCK_SIZE_M")
+            if declared is not None and int(declared) != self.routing_block_size:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"{name} declares BLOCK_SIZE_M={declared}, but the aligned "
+                    f"route uses routing_block_size={self.routing_block_size}"
+                )
+        if set(self.shared_token_delta) != {"reduce", "tail"}:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "shared_token_delta must contain exactly 'reduce' and 'tail'"
+            )
+        for name, tile_key in (("reduce", "BLOCK_SIZE_T"), ("tail", "BLOCK_SIZE_H")):
+            _validate_flat_config(
+                f"shared_token_delta.{name}",
+                self.shared_token_delta[name],
+                frozenset((tile_key, "num_warps", "num_stages")),
+            )
+        _validate_flat_config(
+            "shared_one_pass",
+            self.shared_one_pass,
+            frozenset(("BLOCK_SIZE_H", "num_warps", "num_stages")),
+        )
+
+    def for_a(self, site: Site) -> Mapping[str, int]:
+        return self.gate_up_a if site is Site.GATE_UP else self.down_a
+
+    def for_b(self, site: Site) -> Mapping[str, int]:
+        return self.gate_up_b if site is Site.GATE_UP else self.down_b
+
+    def for_act(self, family: ActFamily) -> Mapping[str, int]:
+        if family is ActFamily.B_ACTIVATION:
+            return self.b_activation
+        raise ValueError(f"{family.value} has no fused-act launch config")

+class TileTable:
+    """Launch configs of one bound plan row, picked per forward by token count."""
+
+    def __init__(self, rules: list[tuple[int, MoeLoraLaunchConfig]]) -> None:
+        self._rules = rules
+
+    def config_for(self, num_tokens: int) -> MoeLoraLaunchConfig:
+        for bound, config in self._rules:
+            if num_tokens <= bound:
+                return config
+        return self._rules[-1][1]

+def _validate_plan_launch_config(plan: MoePlan, config: MoeLoraLaunchConfig) -> None:
+    dot_sites = {}
+    for name, spec in (("gate_up_a", plan.gate_up_a), ("down_a", plan.down_a)):
+        if spec.family in (AFamily.GROUPED, AFamily.TOKEN_GROUPED):
+            dot_sites[name] = ("BLOCK_SIZE_N", "BLOCK_SIZE_K")
+        if (
+            spec.family is AFamily.TOKEN_GROUPED
+            and getattr(config, name).get("SPLIT_K", 1) > 1
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} token_grouped does not provide split-K scratch")
+    for name, spec in (("gate_up_b", plan.gate_up_b), ("down_b", plan.down_b)):
+        if spec is not None and spec.family is BFamily.GROUPED:
+            dot_sites[name] = ("BLOCK_SIZE_N",)
+    if plan.act.family is ActFamily.B_ACTIVATION:
+        dot_sites["b_activation"] = ("BLOCK_SIZE_W", "BLOCK_SIZE_K")
+    if plan.down_b_into_base:
+        dot_sites["down_b"] = ("BLOCK_SIZE_N", "BLOCK_SIZE_K")
+    elif plan.finalize.family is FinalizeFamily.SHARED_TOKEN_DELTA:
+        dot_sites["down_b"] = ("BLOCK_SIZE_N",)
+    for name, tile_keys in sorted(dot_sites.items()):
+        tiles = getattr(config, name)
+        if "GROUP_SIZE_M" not in tiles:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} requires GROUP_SIZE_M for its selected consumer")
+        for key in tile_keys:
+            if tiles[key] < 16:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"{name}.{key} must be at least 16 for its selected consumer"
+                )

+    gate_up_b_family: BFamily = BFamily.GROUPED
+    down_b_family: BFamily = BFamily.GROUPED
+    act_family: ActFamily = ActFamily.MATERIALIZED
+    finalize_family: FinalizeFamily = FinalizeFamily.MATERIALIZED
+    gate_up_overlap: GateUpOverlap = GateUpOverlap.NONE
+    down_overlap: DownOverlap = DownOverlap.NONE

+_CONFIG_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "configs")

+def _validate_tile_ladder(rules: list[_TileRuleModel]) -> None:
+    ranks = {1} | {rule.max_rank + 1 for rule in rules if rule.max_rank is not None}
+    reachable = set()
+    for rank in ranks:
+        previous = 0
+        for index, rule in enumerate(rules):
+            if rule.max_rank is not None and rank > rule.max_rank:
+                continue
+            reachable.add(index)
+            if rule.max_tokens is None:
+                break
+            if rule.max_tokens <= previous:
+                raise ValueError(f"tile token bounds must increase for rank {rank}")
+            previous = rule.max_tokens
+    if len(reachable) != len(rules):
+        raise ValueError("tile rules must not be shadowed for every rank")

+def _read_table(name: str) -> dict | None:
+    from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+
+    override_dir = envs.SGLANG_LORA_MOE_CONFIG_DIR.get()
+    for directory in filter(None, (override_dir, _CONFIG_DIR)):
+        path = os.path.join(directory, name)
+        if os.path.isfile(path):
+            if directory == override_dir:
+                logger.info(
+                    "MoE LoRA table %r loaded from override dir %s", name, directory
+                )
+            with open(path) as handle:
+                return json.load(handle)
+    return None

+    raw = _read_table(f"{architecture}.plans.json")
+    if raw is None:
+        logger.warning(
+            "no MoE LoRA plan table for architecture %s; serving the "
+            "conservative default plans",
+            architecture,
+        )
+        raw = _read_table("default.plans.json")
+    if raw is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("MoE LoRA plan tables are missing from the package")
+    table = _PlansFileModel.model_validate(raw)
+    for row in (*table.scenarios, *table.fallback):
+        layouts = (row.layout,) if row.layout is not None else ("per_expert", "shared")
+        plans = [
+            _build_plan(
+                row.plan,
+                activation=ActivationFn.SILU,
+                is_shared_outer=layout == "shared",
+            )
+            for layout in layouts
+        ]
+        for rule in row.tiles:
+            config = MoeLoraLaunchConfig(**rule.sites)
+            for plan in plans:
+                _validate_plan_launch_config(plan, config)
+        _validate_tile_ladder(row.tiles)
+    return table

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SelectedPlan:
+    name: str
+    base_gemm_rows: str
+    plan: MoePlan
+    tiles: TileTable
+
+
+def _tile_table(rules: list[_TileRuleModel], physical_rank: int) -> TileTable:
+    """Drop the rules the bound rank excludes; keep the token bounds for each forward."""
+    resolved: list[tuple[int, MoeLoraLaunchConfig]] = []
+    for rule in rules:
+        if rule.max_rank is not None and physical_rank > rule.max_rank:
+            continue
+        bound = rule.max_tokens if rule.max_tokens is not None else 1 << 30
+        resolved.append((bound, MoeLoraLaunchConfig(**rule.sites)))
+        if rule.max_tokens is None:
+            break  # An unbounded rule shadows all later rules.
+    if not resolved:
+        resolved.append((1 << 30, MoeLoraLaunchConfig()))
+    return TileTable(resolved)
+
+
+def _build_plan(
+    spec: _PlanSpecModel,
+    *,
+    activation: ActivationFn,
+    is_shared_outer: bool,
+) -> MoePlan:
+    gate_up_a_family = spec.gate_up_a_family
+    gate_up_layout = (
+        BridgeLayout.TOKEN_MAJOR
+        if gate_up_a_family in (AFamily.TOKEN_GROUPED, AFamily.TOKEN_DENSE)
+        else BridgeLayout.PAIR_MAJOR
+    )
+    act_family = spec.act_family
+    finalize_family = spec.finalize_family
+    consumes_gate_up_b = act_family is ActFamily.B_ACTIVATION
+    consumes_down_b = finalize_family is not FinalizeFamily.MATERIALIZED
+    plan = MoePlan(
+        gate_up_a=ASpec(
+            Site.GATE_UP, gate_up_a_family, is_shared_outer, gate_up_layout
+        ),
+        gate_up_b=(
+            None
+            if consumes_gate_up_b
+            else BSpec(
+                Site.GATE_UP,
+                spec.gate_up_b_family,
+                False,
+                gate_up_layout,
+            )
+        ),
+        act=ActSpec(act_family, activation),
+        down_a=ASpec(
+            Site.DOWN,
+            spec.down_a_family,
+            False,
+            BridgeLayout.PAIR_MAJOR,
+        ),
+        down_b=(
+            None
+            if consumes_down_b
+            else BSpec(
+                Site.DOWN,
+                spec.down_b_family,
+                is_shared_outer,
+                BridgeLayout.PAIR_MAJOR,
+            )
+        ),
+        finalize=FinalizeSpec(
+            finalize_family, is_shared_outer if consumes_down_b else False
+        ),
+        gate_up_overlap=spec.gate_up_overlap,
+        down_overlap=spec.down_overlap,
+        route_builder=spec.route_builder,
+        down_b_into_base=spec.down_b_into_base,
+    )
+    return plan
+
+
+@cache
+def _warn_out_of_domain(
+    architecture: str, hidden_size: int, num_local_experts: int
+) -> None:
+    logger.warning(
+        "MoE LoRA geometry (hidden=%d, local_experts=%d) is outside the tuned "
+        "domain of table %r; serving the fallback rows",
+        hidden_size,
+        num_local_experts,
+        architecture,
+    )
+
+
+def resolve_plans(
+    *,
+    architecture: str,
+    is_shared_outer: bool,
+    physical_rank: int,
+    activation: ActivationFn,
+    hidden_size: int,
+    num_local_experts: int,
+    quant_family: str,
+) -> dict[Phase, SelectedPlan]:
+    table = _load_plans(architecture)
+    layout_name = "shared" if is_shared_outer else "per_expert"
+    in_domain = table.domain.admits(
+        hidden_size=hidden_size, num_local_experts=num_local_experts
+    )
+    rows = table.scenarios if in_domain else []
+    if not in_domain:
+        _warn_out_of_domain(architecture, hidden_size, num_local_experts)
+    selected: dict[Phase, SelectedPlan] = {}
+    for phase in Phase:
+        # Earlier rows take precedence, including wildcard rows.
+        row = next(
+            (
+                candidate
+                for candidate in (*rows, *table.fallback)
+                if candidate.layout in (None, layout_name)
+                and candidate.phase in (None, phase)
+                and (candidate.max_rank is None or physical_rank <= candidate.max_rank)
+                and (
+                    candidate.min_local_experts is None
+                    or num_local_experts >= candidate.min_local_experts
+                )
+                and (
+                    candidate.max_local_experts is None
+                    or num_local_experts <= candidate.max_local_experts
+                )
+                and (candidate.quant is None or quant_family in candidate.quant)
+            ),
+            None,
+        )
+        if row is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"no MoE LoRA plan row matches ({layout_name}, {phase.value}) "
+                f"on {architecture}"
+            )
+        selected[phase] = SelectedPlan(
+            name=row.name,
+            base_gemm_rows=row.base_gemm_rows,
+            plan=_build_plan(
+                row.plan,
+                activation=activation,
+                is_shared_outer=is_shared_outer,
+            ),
+            tiles=_tile_table(row.tiles, physical_rank),
+        )
+    return selected
